definitions.formal_definition: A versioned coordination scope binding one Product, thesis, charter, owner, budget, rights policy and disclosure cut.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Open a separately reviewable program before accepting funded work.
definitions.intuition: The container for one product research promise, separate from the product and network.

definitions.formal_definition: A pre-work versioned agreement on program scope, baseline, uncertainties, milestones, decision rules, methods, budget, eligibility, rights and payout policy.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Freeze a charter version before award-eligible work; amendments create successors.
definitions.intuition: What contributors and funders can inspect before work begins.

definitions.formal_definition: A versioned candidate hypothesis, mechanism, case, scorer, evaluator, workflow, study design or product-feedback change with one primary novelty unit and falsifiable claim.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Assign a content identity and primary inquiry; retain all versions and attempts.
definitions.intuition: The thing someone claims to add to research.

definitions.formal_definition: A dated reproducible comparison procedure and corpus identifying local baseline, closest known prior work, queries, exclusions and coverage limits.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Bind each novelty review to this search; no hits does not prove originality.
definitions.intuition: Shows what the candidate was compared against.

definitions.formal_definition: A rule-versioned independent assessment of source-relative operative difference, prediction, evidence, executable contrast, usefulness, harms and execution level.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Record every check as pass, fail or unknown with a bounded disposition.
definitions.intuition: Determines whether an idea differs meaningfully for this purpose.

definitions.formal_definition: A contribution that against a frozen baseline and comparable cost resolves a declared uncertainty, reveals a distinct failure or improves a predeclared research decision on valid evidence.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Require evidence, independent challenge and owner decision for an exact scope.
definitions.intuition: A useful negative result can advance research.

definitions.formal_definition: Bounded performance of an accepted task or protocol under specified quality, cost and evidence requirements regardless of outcome sign.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Assess task conformance separately from originality.
definitions.intuition: Running a good experiment is work even if its idea was already defined.

definitions.formal_definition: A versioned evaluation of contributor claims against baseline, independent evidence, causal role, duplication, conflicts, reproducibility and decision impact.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Separate proposed credit from adjudicated credit and retain appeals.
definitions.intuition: Determines what each contributor actually added.

definitions.formal_definition: A budgeted proposed award for accepted execution work with eligibility, amount, instrument and verification rule fixed before the task.
definitions.operational_interpretation: A candidate award does not mint or transfer any asset.
definitions.intuition: Payment for verified work, not a permanent product share.

definitions.formal_definition: A proposed nontransferable accounting unit for an adjudicated research advance in one program; any revenue treatment depends on a separate enforceable agreement.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Fix allocation, denominator, duration, dilution and legal instrument before issue.
definitions.intuition: A proposed long-term share meter, not automatic IP or equity ownership.

definitions.formal_definition: The amount for a named product and period left after applying a predeclared revenue base, exclusions, refunds, costs, reserves and audit adjustments.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Calculate from reconciled transactions under a fixed policy version.
definitions.intuition: The exact pool an agreement might share, if revenue exists.

definitions.formal_definition: A reconciled calculation and authorized payment instruction for a period, product, policy version, eligible units and distributable revenue.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Verify source receipts, denominator, adjustments, recipient rights and treasury authorization.
definitions.intuition: Shows how much is owed and paid under an agreement.

definitions.formal_definition: Versioned rules for source permissions, contributor licenses or assignments, product IP, data custody, personal-data restrictions and commercial uses.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Never infer a right from token ownership or submission alone.
definitions.intuition: Who may use research, code, IP and data, and for what.

definitions.formal_definition: A dated version-pinned public or permissioned view of thesis, evidence status, budgets, rights, economics, risks and unresolved decisions.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Publication requires a separate owner decision.
definitions.intuition: What a prospective contributor or funder can inspect at a point in time.

definitions.formal_definition: An authorized exchange of eligible utility balance for a specified product service under its current access and data rules.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Require product permission and consent where relevant plus a recorded debit.
definitions.intuition: A token can buy a permitted service; it cannot by itself grant access to personal data.

definitions.formal_definition: A versioned rule fixing eligible execution, budget, verification, instrument, amount calculation and exceptions before work begins.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Bind an accepted task to one policy version and budget before award review.
definitions.intuition: The rules for earning task rewards.

definitions.formal_definition: A versioned rule for qualifying advances, unit allocation, denominator, duration, dilution, corrections and revenue treatment subject to separate agreements.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Freeze the policy before accepting an advance for long-term credit.
definitions.intuition: The rules for proposed long-term participation.

definitions.formal_definition: A versioned owner decision record assigning proposed units to a named contributor under a policy and signed agreement.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Do not issue until adjudication, appeal, contract and denominator are complete.
definitions.intuition: A specific award of participation units.

definitions.formal_definition: A period-specific reconciliation of product receipts and predeclared deductions to distributable revenue.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Attach source transactions and audit before settlement.
definitions.intuition: The accounting statement for one period.

definitions.formal_definition: A versioned owner decision record assigning a budgeted execution reward to a named recipient under a preaccepted task and policy.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Do not mint without verified work, budget and mint authority.
definitions.intuition: A specific reward for completed work.

definitions.formal_definition: A versioned set of explicit checks and dispositions applied to one source-relative Research Object novelty claim.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Pin the exact rule-set version on each review; changes create successors and do not reinterpret old reviews.
definitions.intuition: The checklist and decision rule used to judge a candidate.

definitions.formal_definition: A versioned ceiling and allocation of funds by eligible research work, review, operations and reserves for one program.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Freeze amounts, funding source and spending authority before tasks are offered.
definitions.intuition: What the program can spend and on which purposes.

definitions.formal_definition: A recorded conditional promise or receipt of funds for one program under stated instrument, use, refund, risk and rights terms.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Separate a pledge from cleared funds and verify the exact disclosure cut accepted.
definitions.intuition: What a funder actually committed, under which terms.

definitions.formal_definition: A contributor-authored claim to a specific research or execution role, source artifacts, causal change and requested credit under one charter version.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Preserve submission time, identity, collaborator disclosures and duplicate links before review.
definitions.intuition: The contributor case that an assessor can challenge.

definitions.formal_definition: A versioned interval with a fixed work-token release ceiling, task admission window and closing rule for one policy cut.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Reserve all maximum task liabilities before assignment and reconcile awards at close.
definitions.intuition: The bounded accounting round for mining work.

definitions.formal_definition: A precommitted research work request with exact baseline, evidence and rights rules, slots, bounty, bonus, reviewer compensation, maximum liability and deadlines.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Only an authorized, fully reserved offer may accept miner commitments.
definitions.intuition: The research job miners can choose or receive.

definitions.formal_definition: A timestamped digest binding one miner, task slot, content digest and nonce before reveal.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Check the digest at reveal; commitment alone earns nothing.
definitions.intuition: Seals a proposed answer before others can see it.

definitions.formal_definition: The content, provenance, method, costs, rights declaration and result sign disclosed against a valid commitment.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Verify timing and digest, then screen and review against the frozen task.
definitions.intuition: What the miner actually delivered.

definitions.formal_definition: A reviewer-authored versioned judgment on each predeclared submission gate with evidence, conflict declaration and decision-resolution assessment.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Collect independent signed reviews before an owner decision.
definitions.intuition: A check on the delivered work that the miner cannot self-issue.

definitions.formal_definition: An append-only state transition with exact asset, integer amount, debit, credit, signer nonce, idempotency key, decision reference and prior digest.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Reject replay, overspend and unauthorized asset movement; replay for balances.
definitions.intuition: One auditable movement of value.

definitions.formal_definition: A reconciliation of one epoch cap, task reservations, awards, released remainder and terminal ledger root.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Close only after every task slot is final or expired.
definitions.intuition: How much the mining round promised and actually paid.

definitions.formal_definition: A precommitted maximum unit budget for a named research decision or milestone within one product cap.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Reserve units before evaluating claimants and release unallocated residue after adjudication.
definitions.intuition: The fixed long-term credit budget for one research advance.

definitions.formal_definition: A versioned product-specific rule defining eligible receipts, deductions, share fraction, fixed unit denominator, period, duration, audit and settlement.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Fix contractual parameters before participation units are issued.
definitions.intuition: The formula and boundaries for sharing realized product revenue.

definitions.formal_definition: A versioned Product rule for W price, service capacity, eligibility, consent, marginal cash cost, funding reserve and refund handling.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Reject W redemption until price, capacity and service-cost reserve are fixed and authorized.
definitions.intuition: What a holder can receive for W and whether the Product can deliver it.

definitions.formal_definition: An optional versioned rule for a separately reserved W sale tranche, C price, purchaser rights, settlement, permitted use and refunds.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Do not offer a sale until the tranche, contract, disclosures and legal review are approved.
definitions.intuition: How a funder might buy W without receiving research participation units.

definitions.formal_definition: A versioned program rule selecting whether a funder provides a grant, purchases service W, or receives a separate contractual product-revenue claim, with exact consideration, rights, refund and loss terms.
definitions.operational_interpretation: No financing receipt creates W or U rights without the exact instrument and owner decision.
definitions.intuition: What a funder gives and what, if anything, the funder receives.

definitions.formal_definition: A versioned inventory of actor kinds and candidate role templates for a named Project; it creates no Principal or Role Assignment.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Use it to enumerate participation and role boundaries before governance decisions.
definitions.intuition: Who may participate and which roles might be appointed.

definitions.formal_definition: A versioned set of rule IDs, exact statements, applicability, required evidence, failure effects and owners for one governance scope.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Bind every governed decision to an exact rule cut.
definitions.intuition: The rules the network proposes to follow.

definitions.formal_definition: A versioned mapping from action kinds to proposer, reviewer, approver and executor roles, quorums, separation, evidence and timing.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Check proposed participants and evidence before preparing an owner Decision.
definitions.intuition: Who can do each step and with whom.

definitions.formal_definition: An attributable statement of relationships, common control and interests relevant to a named decision, with recusal scope and challenge route.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Screen all decision participants before review and preserve updates.
definitions.intuition: Why someone may need to step out of a decision.

definitions.formal_definition: A bounded challenge to an exact decision with claimant standing, original evidence cut, new grounds, deadline, independent panel and remedy history.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Freeze affected effects and record a separate appeal outcome before any correction.
definitions.intuition: A traceable route to contest and correct a decision.

common_scope: Agentic Research Network candidate program model
common_boundary: Distinct from existing Lab Product, Project, Goal, Research Inquiry, Experiment Design, Research Run, Evidence, Finding and Decision meanings; no admission or external authority.
claim_ceiling: Task-local candidate definitions; no Lab Definition registry admission.
